title_en: Spacious 2+1+2 apartment for sale at Residence Moa!!!
description_en: At the Moa Residence in Astir, a 2+1+2 apartment with a regular structure is for sale!!! The apartment has a gross area of ​​121 m2 and a net area of ​​104.9 m2 and is located on the 2nd residential floor of a complex with 21 floors. The Moa residence is a multifunctional project very close to the city center. The positioning of the complex near the main road makes it easily accessible and suitable for both investment and residence. The area offers all the necessary services. The internal organization is as follows: the living room connected to the kitchen area and with access to the balcony, two bedrooms, both with access to the balcony, and one with a dedicated toilet and a day toilet.
